minutes.headline: Cable committee voted to recommend all three expiring members for reappointment and began hunting for a studio.
minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee met by Zoom. It accepted prior minutes, heard the manager's report and finances, and voted one at a time to recommend reappointing three members (Pete Lincoln, Faith Beal, Steve) to the select board, each abstaining on their own vote. Members discussed where to put a studio if the building is demolished, and agreed to meet in person in June.

Accept reappointment of Steve and recommend to the select board

budget_items.what_was_said: Footage of town meeting is being put on DVDs for the town manager, sold at a per-copy price.
Hiring delayed in FY21 will go ahead in FY22, a part-time position with benefits that makes a big financial difference.
Members noted the current rent for the TC Passios classroom space while saying commercial rental would be far costlier.
Interest was added to the March numbers.
April expenses were salaries, videographer payroll and HDMI cables not yet on the books.
Indirect costs taken out in July in anticipation of a new part-time employee with benefits are expected back this month.
The committee's balance differed from the town financial report and is being reconciled with the town.
A member referred to a town study of demolishing the building the studio is in.

decisions.decision: Studio relocation options to be put on the next meeting's agenda; members to scout locations.
Chair will add a note to the select board packet suggesting staggered terms (two, two and one).
June 7 meeting to be held in person at the studio at TC Passios, unless rules change.
Scouting new studio locations placed on next month's agenda.

what_happened.line: The Public Access Cable Committee voted to recommend that the select board reappoint all three members whose terms were expiring, each member abstaining on their own vote.
Members discussed where to put a studio if the building that houses it is demolished, and put studio relocation options on the next meeting's agenda.
The chair will add a note to the select board packet suggesting staggered terms for the committee.
The manager's report said a part-time production technician position, delayed in FY21, will go ahead in FY22, and the finances section reconciled the committee's balance with the town's report.
The June 7 meeting will be held in person at the studio, unless the rules change.

why_it_matters: The studio that produces local public-access and town meeting video sits in a building the town has studied for demolition, so a move could change where and at what rent the service operates.
Reappointments and the proposed staggered terms go to the select board, which decides who sits on the committee and how often seats come up.
watch_next: The June 7 meeting, planned in person at the studio, with studio relocation options on the agenda.
The select board's action on the three reappointment recommendations and the staggered-terms note.
